card.name: Word starts after section headings
card.fires_on: The first piece of a word or a short word at a section heading or sentence start, such as B, C, b, or of. It is often where a heading repeats itself in label text.

modes.label: Heading start
modes.description: A letter or short word beginning a new numbered heading or the repeated heading text.

modes.label: Split word
modes.description: A piece partway into a split word such as baseline or mortality.
